result.result:
The app is built and working in `/private/tmp/dsb-eval/opus-5-5/D-1`, but I couldn't see the Figma frames. The token is rejected with "Token expired" (403), both through the Figma MCP server and with a direct call using `$FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN`. So the layout, tile arrangement and badge colours are my reading of the spec and the component library, not a match to the design. Once there's a fresh token, the next step is to compare against the frames.

**What I checked.** `ng build` succeeds. I ran the app with `npx @angular/cli@19 serve` and went through it in a headless Chromium at 1280px and 390px wide. No console errors or warnings.
- **Login:** empty fields and wrong credentials each show an error. `admin`/`admin` sets `isLoggedIn` and goes to `/dashboard`. Opening `/login` while signed in, or `/users` while signed out, redirects correctly, and unknown URLs go to `/login`.
- **Profile menu:** it opens leftward and stays fully on screen at both widths. It closes on an outside click or Escape, and Sign Out logs you out.
- **Create, read, update, delete:** all four go through the in-memory API and the table updates each time. That covers Details, Edit (name split and recombined), Edit → "Delete user" → confirm (the member stays selected), deleting from a row, closing on backdrop click, and Invite (form checks, Active status, today's date, form reset).
- **Log viewer:** a new line appears every 3 seconds.

**Token use.** All UI is built from `dsb-*` components, and every value is a public tier 2 (`--ds-decisions-*`) token. A scan found no tier 1 or tier 3 tokens and no raw colours.

**What the resolver changed:**
- **Chart bars:** the protocol expected a refusal for "pure black". It didn't refuse. It returned `surface-emphasis` (#111111) for "darkest foreground", and the bars use that.
- **Refusals I acted on:**
  - Card border: I asked again in different words and got `border-subtle`.
  - Large display text: it couldn't choose between 2xl and 3xl. I chose 3xl, the largest.
  - Chart height: it offered the app-header height (56px) because both use the word "bar". I didn't use it.
- **Genuine gaps:** there are no tokens for font family, chart height or log panel height. Those three are literals, kept in one place in `dashboard.component.css:6` and marked `no-coverage` so they can be proposed as new tokens. The body font stack in `styles.css` is marked the same way.

**Choices I made without Figma:**
- **Role badges:** Admin solid dark, Editor blue, Viewer grey.
- **Status badges:** Active green, Inactive grey.
- **Dashboard layout:** four metric tiles in a row, then two rows of two panels.
- **Brand and footer:** "Blueprint" and the footer links are my placeholders.

**Workarounds for the component library:**
- **Profile control:** `dsb-header` has no slot for it, so it sits on a layer lined up with the header's right edge.
- **Header and footer links:** they're plain links, so I route them through the Angular router to avoid full page reloads.
- **Avatar fallback:** `dsb-avatar` only shows initials when there's no image URL. A small directive also switches to initials when the image fails to load.

**Setup changes:** the folder had Angular 21 packages installed. I replaced them with a new Angular 19 project and installed `angular-in-memory-web-api@^0.19` plus the two dsb packages.

note: Reclassified as a pilot. Run as D-1, the first run in which the resolver was actually reachable (the earlier D-1 became C-0). Scored before the conformance scorer existed, so it is not comparable with the scored runs. Run 0 marks it outside the five scored runs.
